body:
Fixes #21.

Clicking a network now opens the editor with symmetric loop defaults, cross-like starts and the colors shown at the source. Bend changes free-link curvature and self-loop width; free endpoints stay anchored. Gallery, theory and background-rain geometry retain their original construction.

- Match dark/light colors from gallery cards, share icons and theory examples; remove gallery hover underlines.
- Preserve independent angles, gaps, marker controls, placements, overlap reduction, exports and saved styles. Keep legacy tangent rotation selectable and recognize older explicit custom-color URLs.
- Verify both supplied URLs against their controls, then edit/share/reload to the same SVG. The screenshot values already parsed correctly; inherited defaults and bend construction caused the differences.

### Reproduction and verification

Open `/network/?code=1122` and `/network/?code=00000000`, vary Bend, and compare with gallery navigation. Equal endpoint angles/gaps give point-symmetric loops; free endpoints no longer rotate with Bend. Also hover a gallery card and open it in both themes.

Automated coverage: `src/links/geometry-21.test.js`, `src/pages/network-21.test.jsx`, and `npm run test:network:issue21`. Strict symmetry samples, all 4,181 small editor configurations, and 4,693 unchanged gallery/rain SVG hashes guard geometry and scope. Browser checks verify supplied settings, share/reload, dark/light navigation, hover, SVG export and mobile overflow.

Validation: 693 unit tests pass; repository checks and production build pass; Chromium, Firefox and WebKit pass the new and existing browser suites. CI also verifies CV PDFs and the Pages build artifact.

### Before / after

| Original editor | Updated editor |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: unequal loops and different colors](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-21-823573f25e74/docs/case-studies/issue-21/screenshots/chromium-before-default-1122.png?raw=true) | ![After: symmetric loops and matching colors](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-21-823573f25e74/docs/case-studies/issue-21/screenshots/chromium-after-default-1122.png?raw=true) |
| ![Before: rotated free links](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-21-823573f25e74/docs/case-studies/issue-21/screenshots/chromium-before-default-00000000.png?raw=true) | ![After: anchored curves and cross starts](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-21-823573f25e74/docs/case-studies/issue-21/screenshots/chromium-after-default-00000000.png?raw=true) |

![Editor controls with the first supplied configuration](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-21-823573f25e74/docs/case-studies/issue-21/screenshots/chromium-after-supplied-1.png?raw=true)

[Complete case study, settings audit, requirement inventory, timeline, root causes, library research, raw logs/data and browser evidence](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/tree/issue-21-823573f25e74/docs/case-studies/issue-21). All causes were traced to this application; no external dependency defect required an upstream report.
